verdict.rationale: Windmill's own Git sync pushes a commit to an external repository every time an item is deployed. Flows can be defined in YAML and scripts are plain code, so workspace items leave the product in open formats. The open-source, self-hostable deployment further reduces lock-in. However, nothing in the evidence documents a complete export of all data, such as run history, logs, resources or variables, and the CLI evidence never mentions export. missing for 10: documented full-workspace or all-data export (job history, logs, variables/secrets, resources), explicit export format documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful migration off Windmill.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Each time an item is deployed, Windmill will create and push a commit to the specified repository.
